t_becc0a1ea8cb:0093c06:1:5.AttributionNote: 聯燈會要, Baoshou Zhao section. Baoshou Zhao is the exact speaker who tells the visiting monk that a hundred thousand buddhas do not leave this abbot's quarters.

t_79090ea8b22c:0106a11:1:3.AttributionNote: 聯燈會要, Shimen Cizhao Cong section. Shimen Cizhao Cong is the exact instruction speaker who says that intending with the mind already misses and moving a thought already goes awry.

t_207efae5f6bd:0133b21:1:3.AttributionNote: 聯燈會要, Baofeng Shanqing section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk who asks first for the living phrase and then the dead phrase. All six rungs leave him unnamed.

t_8dc9df82b364:0291c22:1:3.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Yunding Defu section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed music-bureau officer who sets aside swallowing the West River and asks Yunding to swallow the dismounting platform. All six rungs preserve only his office.

t_b0d4b62a9c2f:0300b13:1:1.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Zhihai Benyi section. Zhihai Benyi is the exact hall speaker who says one must have blood beneath the skin and know pain and itching rather than resemble earth and wood.

t_338c380e905a:0304a22:1:4.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Daning Daokuan section. The exact headword-bearing speaker is an unnamed questioning monk who asks why the temple director's brows fell after Danxia burned the wooden buddha. All six rungs leave him unnamed.

t_6457935dff62:0310a22:1:4.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Dahong Bao'en section. Dahong Bao'en is the exact hall speaker who contrasts saying mind itself is buddha with saying neither mind nor buddha, calling the latter like mistaking a reflected head.

t_927d274aa0fc:0314a08:1:5.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Yun'an Kewen section. The Buddha is the exact actor in Yun'an's narrated awakening scene: when the morning star appeared on the eighth day of the twelfth month, Shakyamuni suddenly awakened to the Way.

t_250794fa9636:0315a18:2:3.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Xuefeng Daoyuan biography. The exact headword-bearing speakers are two unnamed debating monks: one says not obscuring causality still did not release the wild-fox body, and the other asks how not falling into causality ever caused such a fall. All six rungs leave both unnamed.

t_d055e572dc64:0327b01:1:6.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Qingyuan Weixin section. Qingyuan Weixin is the exact speaker who recounts his three stages of seeing mountains and waters and says that at his resting place he again sees them as before.

t_338c380e905a:0327b18:1:3.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Sansheng Jichang section. Sansheng Jichang is the exact hall-verse speaker who begins, 'A wooden buddha does not pass through fire.'

t_927d274aa0fc:0334c11:1:2.AttributionNote: 嘉泰普燈錄, Jiuxian Qifu biography. Huanglong Huinan is the exact questioner who asks Jiuxian what he makes of the ancient who awakened to the Way on seeing peach blossoms.
